Demo36 Cocoa, Valentine's Eve — prompts for the layered art (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6 标准制作流程) → project/web_prompts.json for
tools/openai/images.py. Reference: her stream art (Demo14 cocoa_live, copied to assets/art/web/d17_cocoa_live.jpg). The first pose
(cocoa_welcome) becomes the character reference for every other pose. Poses on chroma green (#00B140, "matte": "green"); mouth / blink
variants are masked edits from project/face_points.json (measured on each pose). Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

bg_shop.prompt:
Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference only (do not draw her or her room). Same soft cel-animation style, thin coloured lineart, flat colours. Background plate only, NO people.

A small cosy patisserie at night after closing, seen from a stool at its marble work counter (first person, eye level of a seated person). The counter top runs across the bottom of the picture. On the RIGHT: a stainless built-in oven in a brick wall, its window glowing orange. On the LEFT: the tall stainless door of a walk-in fridge. Behind, in the middle: glass shelves of jars and a wall clock, and the shop's front window and glass door with a pink awning seen from inside, snow falling outside in the dark blue night, warm pendant lamps, a few heart garlands. The centre of the picture is open (a person will stand behind the counter later).

Empty scene, no people. Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

bg_window.prompt:
Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference only (do not draw her or her room). Same soft cel-animation style, thin coloured lineart, flat colours. Background plate only, NO people.

The same small patisserie at night, the corner by its front window: a big window with snow falling outside in the dark blue night and a street lamp, a small round café table with two cups, warm pendant lamp light, heart garland, a wall clock showing midnight on the left. Eye level of a seated person. The centre and right of the picture are open (a person will be placed there).

Empty scene, no people. Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

cocoa_welcome.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER and STYLE reference: draw this exact young woman (face, eyes, hair, ribbons, beret).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation, thin coloured lineart (warm dark brown instead of black), flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone, a warm cosy palette. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy, no bloom. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi), 7 heads tall.

Cocoa, 22: the exact young woman from image 1 — long fluffy wavy chestnut-brown hair, cream ribbons tied in it at both sides, a small cream beret, warm pink eyes, a gentle sweet face. Tonight she wears a cream-and-pink frilly blouse with a big soft collar and a pink patisserie apron with a small heart pocket over it, sleeves pushed up a little.

She stands behind the counter, centre-right, from the waist up, one hand raised in a happy little wave, the other holding a cream dishcloth, head tilted, a sweet surprised-happy smile, cheeks pink. Mouth CLOSED.

Lighting on her: warm golden shop light from above and a soft orange glow from the oven on the RIGHT side of the picture.

Plain flat CHROMA-KEY GREEN background (#00B140), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no counter, no floor line, no shadow and no gradient on the background, no green anywhere on her or her props.

Wide 16:9 game scene. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.

cocoa_welcome_talk.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY her mouth: slightly open as if talking softly, a small natural opening, no teeth showing. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.

cocoa_welcome_blink.prompt: Edit this exact image. Keep EVERYTHING identical — same pose, hands, framing, size, position, hair strands, clothes, colours, lighting and background — and change ONLY her eyes: closed in a natural soft blink (eyelids down, lashes visible); her bangs stay exactly as they are. Do not move, zoom or crop the picture.
